title: Alcoholic
alt: Two-panel comic. A man turns the phrase ‘could be’ into ‘cold beer,’ then has a revelation and declares, ‘That’s it! I’m an alcoholic!’

title: Douchebag
alt: Two-panel comic. A man celebrates winning an online chess game, then says, ‘Yeah, they should have stuck to medicine!’

title: Fool
alt: A tired-looking man wonders, ‘Why?? Why can’t I find the energy?’ while vaping from a device labeled ‘Juulfool.’

title: Artist
alt: A comic artist condemns AI-generated art, briefly imagines using it to finish work and spend time with family, dismisses the idea as bullshit, then resumes drawing alone late at night.
caption: Turns out the process described in the thought bubble doesn't work as reliably as I thought. I'm not going to remove this comic because my mistake is funny. In my defense, an LLM *did* make comic #3 based on the style of #2.

title: Angry moderator
alt: Four-panel comic. A post arguing about freelance-platform fees is automatically removed for containing an external link. The author politely messages the moderators, then is temporarily banned for self-promotion.
